# TTAN decision memory

## Current status

- Position/order: none.
- Thesis: the roughly 30% earnings/guidance breakdown is genuine, but price is severely oversold into $54-$56 support, making immediate puts or a rebound long poorly timed.
- Triggers: bullish only after a confirmed close above $60; bearish re-entry preference is a relief rally into $64-$67 or a confirmed breakdown below roughly $54.20 with fresh option markets.

## 2026-09-09 research

- [`Fundamental`](../research/2026-09-09/180353-TTAN-fundamental.md) and [`technical`](../research/2026-09-09/180526-TTAN-technical.md) research both favored no trade. No option chain was requested because neither an entry trigger nor a favorable timing setup existed.
